## Access

Registration: free account, token or license click-through. You need a free account or an access token, or you must accept a license on the provider's site. Nobody reviews this step.

## Before downloading

1. Register on the provider's site and accept its license.
2. Download all files into one folder, keeping the provider's folder structure.

## Credentials

None. The tool reads no credentials for it.

## Get the data

Download the files into a folder as the steps above say, then import the folder:

```bash
biosignal-data import hcp/meg <folder you downloaded into> --version <label> --dest s3://<bucket>
```
